description: Window functions execute with PostgreSQL-compatible ranking, frames, inheritance, and grouped aggregates
sql: CREATE TABLE diff_window_patients (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, age INT);
INSERT INTO diff_window_patients (id, name, age) VALUES ('p1', 'Ada', 36), ('p2', 'John', 45);
SELECT id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY age) FROM diff_window_patients ORDER BY id;

SELECT id, PERCENT_RANK() OVER ordered, CUME_DIST() OVER ordered, SUM(age) OVER framed FROM diff_window_patients WINDOW base AS (), ordered AS (base ORDER BY age), framed AS (ordered GROUPS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ORDER BY id;
SELECT age, COUNT(*), RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(*)) FROM diff_window_patients GROUP BY age ORDER BY age;
